message.content:
Based on the visual evidence in the image:

1) **The soft blue area is a separate background element (a light blue gradient disc), not part of the avatar image itself.** The avatar (the face) is a distinct circular image layered on top of this larger, lighter blue circle. You can see that the blue disc extends slightly beyond the edges of the face image, creating a "halo" or background effect behind it.

2) **No, the avatar does not have a hard visible drop shadow.** There is no dark, offset shadow beneath or to the side of the circular face image. The only effect creating depth is the soft blue gradient disc acting as a background layer, which gives a subtle sense of elevation but without the harsh edges of a traditional drop shadow.
